items.headline: Edwards runs for 2 TDs in Michigan State's 35-7 win over Eastern Michigan
items.description: — Cam Edwards rushed for 152 yards and two touchdowns and Alessio Milivojevic tossed two touchdown passes Saturday to help Michigan State to a 35-7 victory over Eastern Michigan.

items.headline: Luke Weaver's third touchdown pass lifts San Jose State over Eastern Michigan 27-21
items.description: — Luke Weaver threw three touchdown passes, two to Cooper Hoch, and San Jose State rallied in the fourth quarter to defeat Eastern Michigan 27-21 on Friday night.
